lines.beaver: 너 요즘 결혼 생각 있어? 이상형은 있고?
lines.beaver_en: Thinking about marriage lately? Got an ideal type?
lines.beaver_roman: neo yojeum gyeolhon saenggak isseo? isanghyeongeun itgo?
lines.learner: 이상형은 있지만 결혼 적령기는 따로 없는 것 같아.
lines.en: I have an ideal type, but there's no set age to marry.
lines.roman: isanghyeongeun itjiman gyeolhon jeongnyeonggineun ttaro eomneun geot gata.

lines.beaver: 맞아, 요즘은 서른 넘은 노총각도 흔하지.
lines.beaver_en: Right, older bachelors over thirty are common now.
lines.beaver_roman: maja, yojeumeun seoreun neomeun nochonggakdo heunhaji.
lines.learner: 응, 노총각이란 말 대신 그냥 총각이라고 해.
lines.en: Yeah, people just say bachelor instead of old bachelor.
lines.roman: eung, nochonggagiran mal daesin geunyang chonggagirago hae.

lines.beaver_en: I heard people used to meet through matchmaking.
lines.learner: 응, 중매 대신 이제 소개팅 앱 바람이 불었어.
lines.en: Yeah, now dating apps are all the rage instead.
lines.roman: eung, jungmae daesin ije sogaeting aep barami bureosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Then the way people court must have changed too.
lines.learner: 응, 짝사랑도 문자로 툭 고백하는 판이야.
lines.en: Yeah, people even casually confess a crush by text.
lines.roman: eung, jjaksarangdo munjaro tuk gobaekaneun paniya.

lines.beaver: 하하, 낭만이 좀 없다. 결혼식은 어때?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, not very romantic. What about weddings?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, nangmani jom eopda. gyeolhonsigeun eottae?
lines.learner: 결혼식 전에 함 들어가는 풍습도 거의 없어졌어.
lines.en: The custom of delivering the gift box before the wedding is almost gone.
lines.roman: gyeolhonsik jeone ham deureoganeun pungseupdo geoui eopseojyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Do they still invite lots of guests like before?
lines.learner: 아니, 작은 결혼식 바람이 불어서 하객이 적어.
lines.en: No, small weddings are trendy, so there are few guests.
lines.roman: ani, jageun gyeolhonsik barami bureoseo hagaegi jeogeo.

lines.beaver_en: And the reception? People used to party all night.
lines.learner: 피로연은 짧게 하고 작은 파티로 대신하더라.
lines.en: They keep the reception short and do a small party instead.
lines.roman: piroyeoneun jjalge hago jageun patiro daesinhadeora.

lines.beaver: 결혼 안 하고 같이 사는 사람도 많지?
lines.beaver_en: Lots of people live together without marrying, right?
lines.beaver_roman: gyeolhon an hago gachi saneun saramdo manchi?
lines.learner: 응, 동거가 늘고 성에 대한 인식도 바뀌었어.
lines.en: Yeah, cohabitation is up and views on sex have changed.
lines.roman: eung, donggeoga neulgo seonge daehan insikdo bakkwieosseo.

lines.beaver_en: I hear divorce and remarriage have increased too.
lines.en: Right, the divorce rate is up and remarriage is common now.

lines.beaver_en: Still, I like the idea of a romantic marriage.
lines.en: Me too. In the end, the dream is growing old together!
